title: AAPS 3.3.0: Main Menu Button CGM no longer visible/nor activates DiaKEM DEX G7 App (BYODA)
symptom: On AAPS 3.3.0, the CGM button on the main screen is no longer visible and does not activate the DiaKEM Dexcom G7 app, even though it can still be enabled in configuration. This requires manually switching to the Dexcom app to confirm or disable alarms.
cause: The issue was closed with AAPS 3.3.1.1, and a comment states 'Impossible for Android 11', implying the cause is related to Android 11 limitations.
fix: Upgrade to AAPS 3.3.1.1, which fixes the issue and works perfectly with Android 15.
evidence_quote: Thanks for having realized this "Impossible for Android 11" and already closed issue with AAPS 3.3.1.1. -- works perfectly with Android 15
